dogecoin.text: @ApeMP5 The mention of $Gnocchi, a Solana-based memecoin up 54% in 24 hours, underscores the volatile memecoin market, where tokens can surge rapidly due to social media momentum, as seen with Dogecoin's 2021 rise driven by figures like Elon Musk, per Bitcoinist data.
